checks: 850: The message claims the cost difference totals $850/month across all employees. From the notes: PayCore costs $5.20/employee/month, FinPay costs $4.50/employee/month, and there are 1,250 employees. The per-employee difference is $5.20 - $4.50 = $0.70/month. Across 1,250 employees: $0.70 × 1,250 = $875/month, not $850/month. The arithmetic is incorrect.
